messages.subject: Confidential International Executive Profile | Mining, ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Armstrong Appointments Executive Team,

Your executive headhunting work across mining and complex industrial markets aligns closely with my international leadership profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where major investment, responsible development, institutional trust and cross-border execution intersect. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
